items.reason: Glioblastoma is named in the inclusion criteria (cohort 3: pontine tumours 'proven to be high-grade gliomas (such as anaplastic astrocytoma, glioblastoma, high-grade glioma NOS...)'), a valid naming location, in a multi-tumour trial that also admits 'relapsed or refractory solid tumors including CNS tumors'. The narrow pontine/<=30 y context limits relevance but does not remove explicit eligibility.

items.proposed: enrichment, candidate_matched true, matched_agent repotrectinib (agreed coding stands)
items.reason: The arm 'Phase II, ALK-mutated neuroblastoma Cohort' requires ALK mutation, and the record frames repotrectinib among ALK/ROS/NTRK TKIs ('Any prior treatment with a tyrosine kinase inhibitor (TKI) of ALK/ROS/NTRK does NOT exclude'); ALK is mechanistically linked to repotrectinib. The cohort being closed does not change the registered design.
The record registers five experimental arms/cohorts, none acting as a control; R8 defines 'no' as more than one arm with none working as a control, 'not_applicable' only for single-arm trials.
PK is planned ('look at the way the body absorbs, distributes, and gets rid of repotrectinib'; 'PK expansion cohort') but the sample type is not stated, which W7 codes as unclear.

note: Mixed age (<=30 y, mostly paediatric). The positive candidate_matched_selection comes from a closed ALK-mutant neuroblastoma cohort, not from a GBM-relevant cohort; it goes to D21 human review. Regimen is combination (irinotecan + temozolomide backbone) except the DIPG cohort, which receives repotrectinib monotherapy.
